column1: # shortMnistForCI per-iteration figures on GHC head, released orthotope.
# at -A32m -I0, ox-arrays 0.2.0.1, from the working tree at aaf556d4f with
# contractAst's sort-gather rule commented out, ahead of its removal, and the
# inspection-testing removal that docs/ghc-head-build.md describes, with the
# rest of what building on that compiler took.
# Against RELEASED orthotope 0.1.8.0 from Hackage (verified in the build plan
# as style=global, src=repo-tar), the anchor that does not move while the
# orthotope PR branch churns.  Its checkout counterpart is the *-ghc-head.tsv
# without "released" beside it; do not diff a collection against the wrong
# one, the benchmark names being identical.
# A series of its own: the 9.12.4 files beside it are not its diff targets,
# the change of compiler moving prod allocation 8.9% in the geomean and per
# benchmark from 0.89x to 1.57x in both directions.  Diff a head collection
# against it with --baseline, as the others.
# bytes_per_iter is the allocated-vs-iters OLS slope and is exact (every fit
# here R2 0.999999 or above); it is the instrument.  seconds_per_iter carries
# the machine and the roster, which the position effect moves up to 10%
# (docs/position-effect.md), so a time difference under that is not evidence.
